name: principle
description: Graph explorer and editor for CORE's Contextual Universe

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:client
scripts.install:services: cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../media-service && npm install && cd ../queue-service && npm install
scripts.dev:all: npm run kill && concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:media" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:gateway: cd api-gateway && PORT=3000 npm run dev
scripts.dev:media: cd media-service && PORT=3003 npm run dev
scripts.dev:queue: cd queue-service && PORT=3005 npm run dev
scripts.restart: npm run kill && npm run dev:all
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd media-service && npx prisma migrate dev
